falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single daily session
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern relied on a higher-low structure holding above 4,800 support; a break below invalidates the structural floor and suggests continuation lower, not bottoming

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The pattern's blowoff score of 39 implies contained volatility; sustained VIX >35 indicates panic escalation inconsistent with a completed bottom and suggests the capitulation phase is still active

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below its 20-day moving average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination signals flight-to-safety with risk-off equity momentum, breaking the pattern's typical bottom signature where yields stabilize/rise as equities recover, indicating macro deterioration rather than bottom formation
